syntax_check.preparation: Removed the InDesign-only #target directive before Node parsing.
syntax_check.syntax_style: ES3-compatible source; Node is a modern JavaScript parser, not a dedicated ES3 validator.

mock_tests.name: no active document: no mutations or file writes
unknown frames and links: no mutations or file writes
known missing link: exact PNG, only correct target, geometry, page order, text, embed verified
empty recognized frame: place only in existing frame, fit content, embed
healthy custom replacement in named frame is preserved
missing differently named link in recognized frame is repairable
ambiguous targets fail before file writes or mutation
locked frame fails before file writes or mutation
already embedded link makes no changes
unlink throwing reports failure and retains recovery PNG
unlink no-op is detected as failed embedding
failed extraction makes no document changes

adobe_indesign_actual_execution.note: Validation used an executable mock Adobe DOM. Actual Adobe InDesign runtime behavior has not been tested.
